# Experiment map (generated by `atlas/scripts/build_map.py` on the fork branch `dan_evidence-atlas`, from `data/experiment_map.csv`)

One row per experiment. Checker: Lean = Lean alone; Lean∧ndv = Lean ∧ nd_verify; ndv = nd_verify alone; old ND = pre-`nd_verify` verifiers. Review: R = reviewed, R! = reviewed with result-changing findings, U = unreviewed. Headlines are copied from the source and carry its caveats; the source is the link.
